title: Controlled Substance Stewardship schedule for Prescriptions & Renewals
content:
The Controlled Substance Stewardship Committee fixes, for every class of the Prescriptions & Renewals line, the controlled-substance schedule of the class and the safeguards attached to it: whether a signed controlled-substance agreement must be on file and how many calendar months it stays current, whether the state prescription-monitoring database (OARRS) must be checked before prescribing or renewing and how many calendar days a check stays current for renewals, and whether the prescription must be transmitted by electronic prescribing for controlled substances.

| Class | Controlled-substance schedule | Signed agreement on file | Agreement stays current (calendar months) | Database check required | Database check stays current (calendar days) | Electronic prescribing for controlled substances |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Acute Short-Course Prescription | none | no | 0 | no | 0 | no |
| Standard Maintenance Prescription | none | no | 0 | no | 0 | no |
| Monitored Maintenance Prescription | none | no | 0 | no | 0 | no |
| Schedule III-V Controlled Prescription | III-V | yes | 12 | yes | 90 | yes |
| Schedule II Controlled Prescription | II | yes | 12 | yes | 90 | yes |
| Specialty Medication Prescription | none | no | 0 | no | 0 | no |

A 0 in either "stays current" column means the item is not applicable to the class. Only the two controlled classes carry a schedule other than "none", and both carry the same agreement term of 12 calendar months and the same database-check currency of 90 calendar days.
